outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation/resizing; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating image spacing; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel c shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating insets/zoom; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel d shows a series of micrographs at different brightness/contrast settings; no plot or averaged data is presented.
Panel e shows schematic color/background icons and micrographs illustrating channel annotation; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel f shows schematic diagrams and grayscale micrographs illustrating channel separation; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel g shows schematic calibration scale illustrations and micrographs with intensity legends; not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
